page.layout: One block of text: running head at top; the Greek and Latin paragraph in full width; then the word FINIS centred; then the catchword "IN-" at the lower right. Single printed page, no margin notes.

main_text.p: πολλοὶ τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γεὼς ἰδρυμένων ἐκ σιδήρε ςαυρῶν, ὑπενεγκεῖν δ̀ δυνάμενος τὴν τῶ πνευμα̂τος βίαν : Tunc cecidêre multa crucium, quæ templis impôni è ferro solent, sufferre non valentes vim venti.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The Greek line is set in a small Greek type and is transcribed as closely as the scan allows; the accents and breathings on the first line are uncertain. The catchword "IN-" is a hyphenated catchword at the foot right. The "240" running number and "NOTÆ AD LIB. III." head are printed at the top. Show-through and stains omitted.
